Field.name: Setname
Field.manpage: Root name of dataset (omit the a or b)

Field.name: TransferBtoA
Field.usage: Transfer fiducials in backwards direction, from B to A
Field.manpage: Transfer backwards, from the "b" axis to the "a" axis. You will generally not need to specify any filenames with this option.

Field.name: AImageFile
Field.usage: Name of axis A image file (default taken from tracka.com)
Field.manpage: Set the name of the image file upon which the fiducial model for the "a" axis tilt series was built; the default is to take the name from the tracka.com command file.

Field.name: BImageFile
Field.usage: Name of axis B image file (default taken from trackb.com)
Field.manpage: Set the name of the image file for tracking beads in the "b" axis tilt series; the default is to take the name from the trackb.com command file.

Field.name: FiducialModel
Field.usage: Name of source axis fiducial model (default setnamea.fid, or setnameb.fid with -b option)
Field.manpage: Set the name of the fiducial model file for the first, already tracked tilt series; the default is setnamea.fid (or setnameb.fid with the \fB-b\fR option.)

Field.name: SeedModel
Field.usage: Name of output file (default setnameb.seed, or setnamea.seed with -b option)
Field.manpage: Set the name of the output file for the seed model; the default is setnameb.seed (or setnamea.fid with the \fB-b\fR option.)

Field.name: BoundaryModel
Field.usage: Model file with boundary contours to transform, instead of transferring a seed
Field.manpage: Model file with boundary contours around areas to correlate in the A stack, which will be transformed to fit the B stack. The program will find the best matching pair of views in the image stacks, and then transform this model appropriately instead of trying to transfer seed points. The fiducial model file need not exist. If the file name does not begin with "setnamea" (or "setnameb" with the \fB-b\fR option), the \fB-o\fR option must be entered with an output file name.

Field.name: ViewsToSearch
Field.usage: Number of views to search to find best pair (default $nviews)
Field.manpage: Set the number of views from each data set to include in the search for the best matching pair of views; the default is 5.

Field.name: ACenterView
Field.usage: Number of view in A to center search around (default is view closest to zero tilt in setnamea.rawtlt)
Field.manpage: Set the number of the view from the "a" axis tilt series around which to search for the best match; the default is the view nearest to zero tilt, using tilt angles in the file setnamea.rawtlt or tilt angles implied by FirstTiltAngle and TiltIncrement entries in tracka.com.

Field.name: BCenterView
Field.usage: Number of view in B to center search around (default is view closest to zero tilt in setnameb.rawtlt)
Field.manpage: Set the number of the view from the "b" axis tilt series around which to search for the best match; the default is the view nearest to zero tilt, using tilt angles in the file setnameb.rawtlt or tilt angles implied by FirstTiltAngle and TiltIncrement entries in trackb.com.

Field.name: AngleOfRotation
Field.usage: Rotation direction or angle to search (+1, -1, +90, -90 all work, default is to search both directions)
Field.manpage: Use this option to specify the direction of rotation from the first to the second axis. Only the sign of this number matters, so you can enter -1 or -90 for clockwise rotations, or 1 or 90 for counterclockwise rotations. In the absence of this option, the program will consider both directions of rotation.

Field.name: MirrorXaxis
Field.usage: Mirror one image around X axis (1), do not mirror (-1), or try with and without mirroring (0, the default)
Field.manpage: This option controls whether the image from one stack is mirrored around the X axis before rotating by 90 degrees. Enter 1 to mirror always, -1 to never mirror, or 0 to have the program assess both with and without mirroring. The default is 0.

Field.name: RunMidas
Field.usage: Run Midas to set initial translational/rotational alignment
Field.manpage: Run Midas on the first pair of views, and use the alignment that you set in Midas as the initial alignment for all pairs of views that are considered.

Field.name: ScanRotationMaxAndStep
Field.usage: Maximum angle and step size to scan for best rotation, or one angle and 0
Field.manpage: Either the maximum angle and angular step size at which to apply rotation in order to estimate the best rotation; or a single rotation angle to apply and a 0 step size; or 0,0 for no rotation scan (legacy behavior). In the latter case, or when the rotation scan finds the best rotation at the end the range, an initial run of Xfsimplex(1) will be done to search for rotation/translation only. The default is 20 and 4, which will accommodate inaccuracies in 90-degree rotation of up to ~22 degrees, and give fairly accurate interpolated rotation values that allow the first Xfsimplex(1) step to be skipped.

Field.name: CorrespondingCoordFile
Field.usage: File to place corresponding coordinates in
Field.manpage: Use this option to have corresponding fiducial coordinates on the best matching views placed into an output file. This file will also record the section numbers in the two sets and whether the transfer was from "b" to "a".

Field.name: LowestTiltTransformFile
Field.usage: File in which to save transform for lowest tilt pair of views

Field.name: LeaveTempFiles
Field.usage: Leave temporary files in temporary directory
Field.manpage: For diagnosing problems, leave temporary files in the standard temporary directory (/usr/tmp, /tmp, or defined by IMOD_TMPDIR) or in the current directory if there is no temporary directory.
